curatedMovie.curiosityHook: What will thirty days of fast food and no exercise reveal as doctors track Spurlock’s weight?
curatedMovie.description: To examine obesity in America, filmmaker Morgan Spurlock embarks on an extreme thirty-day test: eating nothing but McDonald's meals three times a day, dropping all exercise, and letting doctors track the toll.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: An accessible, engaging documentary with steady pacing and a thoughtful look at personal health.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Spurlock turns an unconventional personal challenge into a thoughtful, eye-opening investigation into diet and the fast-food industry.
